name: Coaching Tree (coaching-tree.app) — cached MCP responses
note: A MODERN AGGREGATOR. observed_at is the fetch date, not the season, which is why it LOSES to a club's own contemporaneous publication on role titles (policy@v4).

coverage.confirmed_absent: nothing before 1951 in this cache - the pre-1936 CSV is the only material for that era

person_id_scheme.warning: A NAME-DERIVED slug has the namesake problem built in. Unlike StatsCrew's counter it carries no disambiguator, so it is usable as a WITHIN-SOURCE key and NOT as evidence of identity across sources.

birth_date.verdict: 100% populated - but see known_conflicts; presence is not agreement

roles.verdict: MODERN title structure. Measured wrong on 3 of 5 teams checked against the clubs' own 1979 guides - it projects modern coordinator titles onto teams that did not use them.

discriminators.reason: the slug is name-derived and carries no collision counter

scores.method: cross-check against clubs' own media guides
scores.consequence: LOSES to media-guides on role_title under policy@v4

known_conflicts.subject: George Allen (coach)
known_conflicts.also: college Alma here vs Marquette there; career_span 1957-1984 here vs 1966-1984 there
known_conflicts.note: The career-span difference is NOT a conflict - StatsCrew's c- namespace holds head-coaching years only, confirmed independently. The birth year IS.

_documentation_only.name: the source's human name; code keys on source_id
_documentation_only.local: where the files sit on this machine; the scripts take paths as arguments
_documentation_only.coverage: a record of what was measured to exist, addressed to a reader
_documentation_only.fields: a human inventory; field_availability is the enforced one
_documentation_only.scores: provenance scoring notes, not yet an implemented policy
_documentation_only.known_conflicts: worked examples of conflicts already seen
_documentation_only.person_id_scheme: how the source builds its ids, with the traps; the ingest follows cross-reference links rather than parsing ids
_documentation_only._rule: keys addressed to a reader and to no code path. Everything NOT listed here must be read by something in src/ - see src/gate_declarations_are_read.py. This list living in the declaration rather than in the gate means widening it shows up in a diff.
